summary.short: Italian decree implementing EU Directive 2019/790 on copyright in the Digital Single Market by amending Law 633/1941. It adds text-and-data-mining exceptions, press publisher rights, and liability and licensing rules for online content-sharing services, from 12 December 2021.
summary.long: Legislative Decree 177/2021 implements Directive (EU) 2019/790 by amending Law 633/1941; the text provided contains only Art. 1 of the decree. It adds a press publisher right for online use of journalistic publications by information society service providers, with fair remuneration set by a regulation of the Communications Authority (AGCOM) if the parties do not agree (Art. 43-bis). It adds exceptions for educational use (Art. 70-bis), research text and data extraction (Art. 70-ter), and a general text and data extraction exception that rights holders may expressly reserve (Art. 70-quater). It sets a liability regime for online content-sharing service providers, with a separate regime for services under three years old with turnover below 10 million euro (Arts 102-sexies to 102-decies), and a licensing scheme for out-of-commerce works held by cultural heritage institutions (Arts 102-undecies to 102-septiesdecies). It sets transparency duties towards authors and performers, with AGCOM dispute resolution and administrative fines of up to 1% of turnover (Arts 110-ter to 110-sexies); those duties apply from 7 June 2022. The document header lists entry into force on 12 December 2021.

notes: Operative text is Art. 1 only, which amends Law 633/1941 by letters a) to s). The Notes section restates amended provisions of Law 633/1941 as they read after amendment; those restatements are not coded as new obligations or events. The title says the directive amends Directives 96/9/CE and 2001/29/CE; this decree does not amend those directives. Art. 1(1)(h) abrogates Art. 69-quater(12) of Law 633, shown as abrogato in the restated text. Several provisions replace references to the procedure under Art. 4 of D.Lgs.Lgt. 20 luglio 1945, n. 440 with procedures set by AGCOM regulation. Art. 110-sexies(1) refers to articolo 110-quinques, apparently meaning 110-quinquies. Empty target_instrument_id and lei/ticker fields are left as empty strings because the schema requires strings and no registry IDs or identifiers were verified.

obligations.summary: To avoid liability for unauthorised uploads, content-sharing providers must, after a sufficiently reasoned notice, expeditiously disable access to or remove the notified works and make best efforts to prevent their future upload; the same article also requires best efforts to obtain authorisation.
obligations.conditional_on: exemption from liability under Art. 102-septies(1)

evidence.quote: tempestivamente disabilitato l'accesso o rimosso dai propri siti web le opere o gli altri materiali oggetto di segnalazione

obligations.summary: Content-sharing providers must provide rights holders, on request and promptly, complete and adequate information on how the liability-exemption measures are implemented and on use under licence agreements.
obligations.conditional_on: request by rights holders

evidence.quote: forniscono tempestivamente ai titolari dei diritti, su richiesta di questi ultimi, informazioni complete e adeguate

obligations.summary: Content-sharing providers with more than 5 million average monthly unique visitors in the previous calendar year must show best efforts to prevent future uploads of notified works for which rights holders supplied relevant information.
obligations.conditional_on: more than 5 million average monthly unique visitors in the previous calendar year; applies to new providers under Art. 102-octies(1) that have the exemption

evidence.quote: devono dimostrare altresì di aver compiuto i massimi sforzi per impedire il futuro caricamento di opere o di altri materiali segnalati

obligations.summary: Content-sharing providers must inform their users, in their terms and conditions, of the possibility to use works under the copyright exceptions.

evidence.quote: informano i propri utenti, tramite la comunicazione dei loro termini e condizioni del servizio, della possibilità di utilizzare opere

obligations.summary: Decisions on rights holders' requests to disable or remove content are subject to human review.
obligations.conditional_on: rights holders' requests to disable access to or remove specific works under Art. 102-decies(1)

evidence.quote: Le decisioni sulla richiesta di disabilitazione o la rimozione dei contenuti sono soggette a verifica umana.

obligations.summary: Content-sharing providers must immediately notify users when content has been disabled or removed at a rights holder's request.
obligations.conditional_on: disabling or removal under Art. 102-decies(1)

evidence.quote: Il prestatore dà immediata comunicazione agli utenti dell'avvenuta disabilitazione o rimozione.

obligations.summary: Content-sharing providers must set up and make available to users fast and effective complaint mechanisms against disabling or removal decisions.

evidence.quote: istituiscono e rendono disponibili agli utenti dei servizi meccanismi di reclamo celeri ed efficaci

obligations.summary: AGCOM must adopt guidelines for the complaint mechanisms of content-sharing providers.

evidence.quote: A tal fine l'Autorità per le garanzie nelle comunicazioni adotta apposite linee guida.

obligations.summary: Contested content must remain disabled while a complaint decision is pending.
obligations.conditional_on: a complaint under Art. 102-decies(2) is pending

evidence.quote: Nelle more della decisione sul reclamo, i contenuti in contestazione rimangono disabilitati.

obligations.summary: AGCOM must set by regulation the modalities for appeals against content-sharing providers' complaint decisions.
obligations.applies_from: within 60 days of entry into force of the provision

evidence.quote: secondo le modalità da essa definite tramite regolamento, da adottare entro sessanta giorni dalla data di entrata in vigore della presente disposizione

obligations.summary: The Minister of Culture may by decree identify further specific requirements for defining out-of-commerce works.
obligations.conditional_on: prior consultation with rights holders, collective management organisations and cultural heritage institutions

evidence.quote: Con decreto del Ministro della cultura possono essere individuati ulteriori requisiti specifici

obligations.summary: Cultural heritage institutions must assess, with reasonable effort and in good faith, whether works in their permanent collections are out of commerce, consulting appropriate sources and, where relevant, checking availability in third countries.
obligations.conditional_on: determining whether a work in the institution's permanent collections is out of commerce

evidence.quote: ne valutano la disponibilità effettiva nei canali commerciali abituali, compiendo un ragionevole sforzo

obligations.summary: A cultural heritage institution that establishes an out-of-commerce work must request a non-exclusive non-commercial licence from the competent collective management organisation, attaching its availability verification documentation.
obligations.conditional_on: the institution has established that the work is out of commerce under Art. 102-undecies

evidence.quote: richiede all'organismo di gestione collettiva di cui al decreto legislativo 15 marzo 2017, n. 35 rappresentativo dei titolari dei diritti per tipologia di opera o di diritto oggetto della licenza, il rilascio di una licenza non esclusiva

obligations.summary: A collective management organisation receiving a licence request must inform all rights holders and verify the adequacy of the availability check; if inadequate it must request further information or reject the request.
obligations.conditional_on: receipt of a licence request under Art. 102-duodecies

evidence.quote: informa tutti i titolari dei diritti e accerta l'adeguatezza della verifica della disponibilità nei canali commerciali abituali

obligations.summary: The Ministry of Culture must publish on its institutional website the licence requests it receives from the collective management organisation.
obligations.conditional_on: adequacy of the availability check has been confirmed

evidence.quote: comunica la richiesta di licenza al Ministero della cultura, che la pubblica nel proprio sito istituzionale

obligations.summary: After 30 days from publication, and absent objection by rights holders, the collective management organisation grants the licence and communicates it, with relevant information, to the EU portal run by EUIPO.
obligations.conditional_on: no objection by rights holders within 30 days of publication

evidence.quote: Trascorsi trenta giorni dalla data di pubblicazione, l'organismo di gestione collettiva, in mancanza di opposizione da parte dei titolari dei diritti, rilascia la licenza

obligations.summary: If rights holders exclude works from the licensing mechanism after a licence was granted, the collective management organisation must revoke the licence and notify the cultural heritage institution and the Ministry of Culture.
obligations.conditional_on: exclusion by rights holders under Art. 102-quaterdecies(1) after licence grant

evidence.quote: Se l'esclusione interviene dopo il rilascio della licenza, l'organismo di gestione collettiva la revoca e ne dà comunicazione

obligations.summary: Before a work is published on a cultural heritage institution's website under the Art. 102-duodecies(4) exception, the publication must be preceded by notice to the EU portal; uses may start only six months after publication on the portal.
obligations.applies_from: six months after publication on the EU portal
obligations.conditional_on: use under the exception of Art. 102-duodecies(4)

evidence.quote: La pubblicazione sul sito web dell'opera deve essere preceduta dalla comunicazione al portale unico europeo

obligations.summary: The Ministry of Culture must promote regular dialogue between user and rights-holder representative bodies to facilitate the out-of-commerce licensing procedures.

evidence.quote: Il Ministero della cultura promuove un regolare dialogo tra gli organismi rappresentativi degli utilizzatori e dei titolari di diritti

obligations.summary: On request, AGCOM must provide guidance on suitable negotiation solutions, including fee determination, for audiovisual works on video-on-demand services.
obligations.conditional_on: request by a party facing difficulty reaching a licence agreement

evidence.quote: che fornisce indicazioni sulle opportune soluzioni negoziali

obligations.summary: Licensees, transferees and their successors must provide authors and performers, at least every six months, with updated, relevant and complete information on exploitation and remuneration; sublicensees must provide supplementary information on request, and AGCOM supervises.

evidence.quote: I soggetti ai quali sono stati concessi in licenza o trasferiti i diritti e i loro aventi causa hanno l'obbligo di fornire agli autori e artisti interpreti e esecutori

obligations.summary: Where the agreed remuneration is disproportionately low relative to the revenues from exploitation, the counterparty must pay authors and performers additional, adequate and fair remuneration.
obligations.conditional_on: agreed remuneration proves disproportionately low relative to revenues over time; not applicable to collective management contracts under Art. 2(1)-(2) of Decreto legislativo 35/2017

evidence.quote: hanno diritto a una remunerazione ulteriore, adeguata ed equa, dalla parte con cui hanno stipulato un contratto

obligations.summary: AGCOM must resolve disputes over the transparency obligations and the contract-adjustment mechanism within 90 days of the request.
obligations.conditional_on: request by a party, or by representative bodies on a specific request of authors or performers

evidence.quote: che risolve la controversia nel termine di novanta giorni dalla richiesta

obligations.summary: AGCOM must adopt a regulation setting the procedure for resolving the disputes under Art. 110-sexies.
obligations.applies_from: within 60 days of entry into force of the provision

evidence.quote: in conformità a quanto stabilito da apposito regolamento, da adottare entro sessanta giorni dalla data di entrata in vigore della presente disposizione

obligations.summary: The exploitation of a work or performance must take place within the term set by the contract, not longer than five years or two years after the publisher or producer made it available; otherwise the author or performer sets a reasonable term.
obligations.conditional_on: unless otherwise provided by contract or by law

evidence.quote: lo sfruttamento dell'opera o della prestazione artistica deve avvenire nel termine stabilito dal contratto

obligations.summary: Sums collected by a collective management organisation under Art. 180-ter that are not claimed by the rights holder must be kept available for the period in Art. 19 of Decreto legislativo 35/2017.
obligations.conditional_on: sums not claimed by the rights holder under Art. 180-ter(1)

evidence.quote: vengono tenute a disposizione per il periodo indicato dall'articolo 19 del decreto legislativo 15 marzo 2017, n. 35

obligations.summary: AGCOM must adopt a regulation setting criteria for determining the representativeness of collective management organisations, publicity measures for the licences, and the procedure for the rights-holder exclusion under Art. 180-ter(2).
obligations.applies_from: within three months of entry into force of Art. 180-ter

evidence.quote: Con regolamento dell'Autorità per le garanzie nelle comunicazioni, da adottare entro tre mesi dalla data di entrata in vigore del presente articolo

enforcement.authority: Autorità per le garanzie nelle comunicazioni
enforcement.triggered_by: Failure to communicate the data needed to determine the equo compenso within thirty days of a request made under Art. 43-bis, comma 12 (the Authority's sanction applies in case of non-communication of such data within thirty days of the request)
enforcement.max_penalty_text: fino all'uno per cento del fatturato realizzato nell'ultimo esercizio chiuso anteriormente alla notifica della contestazione

enforcement.cure_period: None stated; the thirty-day period for providing the data is a precondition of the sanction, not a cure period

evidence.provision: Art. 1, comma 1, lett. c) (inserting Legge 633/1941, Art. 43-bis, comma 12)
evidence.quote: l'Autorità applica una sanzione amministrativa pecuniaria a carico del soggetto inadempiente fino all'uno per cento del fatturato realizzato nell'ultimo esercizio chiuso anteriormente alla notifica della contestazione

enforcement.authority: Autorità per le garanzie nelle comunicazioni
enforcement.triggered_by: Violation of the information and transparency obligations in Art. 110-quater, paragraphs 1, 2 and 3 (information to authors and performers on exploitation, revenues and remuneration)
enforcement.max_penalty_text: fino all'1 per cento del fatturato realizzato nell'ultimo esercizio chiuso anteriormente alla notifica della contestazione
enforcement.penalty_formula: Up to 1% of turnover realised in the last financial year closed before notification of the contestation
enforcement.penalty_reference: Legge 22 aprile 1941 n. 633, Art. 110-quater, comma 4 (inserted by Art. 1, comma 1, lett. q)); payment in reduced amount under Art. 16 of Legge 24 novembre 1981, n. 689 expressly excluded

evidence.provision: Art. 1, comma 1, lett. q) (inserting Legge 633/1941, Art. 110-quater, comma 4)
